reuse.reason: No official public site identity service exists. This minimal observable reads the existing public site-config endpoint once at app startup and refreshes only after an explicit saved site edit. The exported title-face adapter implements the stable official LocaleFace contract for the locale-label fork installation seam: only common/brand.localBuild projects published localized document titles, while all other translations delegate to the original locale service. Official DocumentTitle alone retains browser title and session-prefix behavior; no dictionary, layout or DOM ownership is replaced.
